description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewayBootstrapAuth functionality within the ai.openclaw.app Android application, specifically testing authentication and TLS fingerprint handling related to gateway connections.

classes.name: GatewayBootstrapAuthTest
classes.description: Unit test class for Gateway-related authentication and TLS fingerprint handling within the ai.openclaw.app Android app.

methods.name: skipsOperatorSessionWhenOnlyBootstrapAuthExists
methods.description: Tests that the system correctly skips operator session connection when only bootstrap authentication is provided.

methods.name: connectsOperatorSessionWhenSharedPasswordOrStoredAuthExists
methods.description: Verifies that connection occurs when shared password or stored auth tokens are present.

methods.name: resolveOperatorSessionConnectAuthUsesStoredTokenPathAfterBootstrapHandoff
methods.description: Tests that the auth resolves to a null token after bootstrap handoff, indicating stored token usage.

methods.name: resolveOperatorSessionConnectAuthPrefersExplicitSharedAuth
methods.description: Checks that explicit shared token auth overrides other auth sources.

methods.name: resolveGatewayConnectAuth_prefersExplicitSetupAuthOverStoredPrefs
methods.description: Ensures explicit setup bootstrap token in connection auth takes precedence over stored preferences.

methods.name: acceptGatewayTrustPrompt_preservesExplicitSetupAuth
methods.description: Simulates accepting a gateway trust prompt, verifying that the bootstrap token remains as explicitly specified.

methods.name: connect_showsSecureEndpointGuidanceWhenTlsProbeFails
methods.description: Tests that appropriate message is shown when TLS fingerprint probe fails, indicating no TLS endpoint detected.

methods.name: waitForGatewayTrustPrompt
methods.description: Helper to wait for a pending gateway trust prompt to appear.

methods.name: waitForStatusText
methods.description: Helper function to wait for a specific status text update from NodeRuntime.

methods.name: desiredBootstrapToken
methods.description: Retrieves the desired bootstrap token from a runtime's session object via reflection.

methods.name: readField
methods.description: Utility to reflectively read a field value from an object, traversing superclasses if necessary.
